documents.title: Renew your season subscription
documents.text:
To: Subscribers
From: Marlowe Theatre Box Office
Date: May 12

Dear subscriber,
It is time to renew your subscription for the 2025-26 season, which includes six productions beginning with the musical "Starlight" in September. Subscribers who renew by June 15 keep their current seats and save 20 percent off single-ticket prices. After June 15, seats will be released to new subscribers. You may pay in full or in three monthly installments with no interest. New this year: subscribers can exchange tickets for another performance of the same show up to 24 hours in advance, free of charge. To renew, log in at marlowetheatre.example or call 555-0129 between 10 a.m. and 5 p.m.

documents.title: Harbor City FC Names New Coach
documents.text: HARBOR CITY (January 9) - Harbor City FC announced Thursday that Elena Marchetti will take over as head coach, replacing Tom Bradley, who resigned in December after a disappointing season. [A] Marchetti, 44, led the Westport Rangers to two league titles in four years and is known for a focus on youth development. [B] "Marchetti wants to build a team that plays attractive football and develops players from our own academy," said club president Alan Dube. [C] The club finished ninth last season, its lowest position in a decade, and attendance dropped by 15 percent. [D] Marchetti has signed a three-year contract and will begin work on February 1; the first match under the new coach will be on March 2.

documents.text: The Alder Hotel, a 90-room boutique hotel in the historic district, seeks a Front Desk Agent for the evening shift (3 p.m. to 11 p.m.). documents.title: Invitation to speak
documents.text:
Pacific Rim Marketing Forum
San Diego, California
July 22

Dear Dr. Dube,
On behalf of the organizing committee, I am delighted to invite you to deliver the closing keynote at the Pacific Rim Marketing Forum on October 23. Your talk should last 45 minutes, followed by questions. We offer an honorarium of $3,000, economy airfare, and two nights at the conference hotel. Please let us know by August 15 whether you can accept.
Sincerely,
Peter Collins
Forum Director

Naledi Dube

documents.title: Chef Opens Seafood Restaurant on the Pier
documents.text: PORT HADLEY (June 3) - Chef Antonio Rossi has opened Salt & Anchor, a 70-seat seafood restaurant on the Port Hadley pier. The menu features fish delivered daily from local boats, with main courses priced from $22 to $38. The restaurant also includes an oyster bar and an outdoor terrace overlooking the harbor. Rossi, who previously ran kitchens in Boston and Lisbon, said that returning to the hometown allows cooking with "the ingredients I grew up with." Salt & Anchor is open Wednesday through Sunday for dinner, with weekend brunch beginning in July.

documents.title: Fresh seafood, slow service
documents.text:
Salt & Anchor: 4 stars out of 5
Posted by Priyanka D., June 29

We visited Salt & Anchor on a Friday night. The grilled octopus and the fish stew were both delicious, and the oysters were extremely fresh. The terrace has beautiful views of the harbor at sunset, but it gets windy, so bring a jacket. Service was friendly but slow; we waited 25 minutes for our first course. Main courses were reasonably priced, though the dessert menu was limited. We plan to come back for brunch once it begins next month.

documents.title: TaskFlow Project Management: Pricing
documents.text:
Starter: $8 per user per month. Up to 10 users, 5 projects, 2 GB of storage.
Team: $15 per user per month. Unlimited projects, 50 GB of storage, time tracking, and priority e-mail support.
Business: $25 per user per month. Adds advanced reports, single sign-on, and phone support.

Annual billing saves 20 percent. All plans include a 30-day free trial. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time; changes apply at the next billing cycle.
